credits.title: PostHuman
credits.overview: Six visions of a near future, reshaped by technology, where the line between human and machine blurs and where progress comes at the cost of our humanity.

credits.title: Playback
credits.overview: When a mysterious camcorder appears in their home, a couple's buried sins manifest in terrifying ways.

credits.title: Fresh Meat
credits.overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

credits.title: Madam
credits.overview: An unlucky man becomes a pawn in a mischievous ghoul's deadly game.

credits.title: The Anchoress
credits.overview: In the Middle Ages, a young woman pursues holy solitude in the wild -- but when a horrifying trespasser emerges from the woods, she must fight for her life.

credits.title: Dagnabbit!
credits.overview: A homeowner. A crawlspace. An unwanted guest.

credits.title: To Hell With You
credits.overview: A stubborn demon and a tenacious angel quarrel about the fate of a young man's soul after a botched exorcism.

credits.title: It Draws Closer
credits.overview: A young woman discovers the creature she just sketched is in the bedroom with her.

credits.title: The Mages of Rage and the Desecration of the House of Mimicry
credits.overview: A loud ass punk band faces off with a demonic mime intent on stopping them from finishing their music video, in this award-winning horror comedy short film from Heebie-Jeebies Pictures.

credits.title: Checkpoint
credits.overview: After mysteriously awakening in a barren alien landscape, a self-serving prisoner must conquer a series of grueling trials in order to reunite with his lost love.

credits.title: Disembodies
credits.overview: A lovelorn underdog buys a novelty meteorite as part of a romantic gesture to win his ex back, but when the gift proves to have a mind of its own, he must purge himself of the parasitic entity before it consumes him.

credits.title: Fenestra
credits.overview: A heartbroken woman must cope with her cheating boyfriend, and an incoming alien invasion.

credits.title: Patient
credits.overview: After escaping a cult suicide, a paraplegic hospital patient is tormented by malevolent spirits and cursed to kill whomever hears her voice, unless she offers up the soul of her innocent nephew in place of her own.
